title: Declassified Air Force documents on UFOs at Cold War nuclear sites
place_text: Hanford, Washington; Savannah, South Carolina; Fort Hood, Texas; Los Alamos; Malmstrom; F.E. Warren

tellings.quote: From hundreds of declassified Air Force documents, we now know that UFO sightings were happening across all American nuclear production, missile storage and deployment sites throughout the Cold War,

plain: UFO sightings happened at American nuclear production, missile storage and deployment sites throughout the Cold War, at places like Hanford in Washington, Savannah in South Carolina, Fort Hood in Texas, Los Alamos, and the missile bases Malmstrom and F.E. Warren. Michels says this is known from hundreds of declassified Air Force documents, which he cites as a group without quoting any. If true, it would mean these objects showed a lasting interest in America's nuclear weapons.
